name: Moreno Valley Mall
summary: Old-school retail complex offering brand-name stores, a food court, a multiplex cinema & bowling.
description: Moreno Valley Mall is an enclosed regional shopping destination featuring Harkins Theatres MV 16 and a diverse mix of retail stores, dining, and entertainment options. The mall serves the Moreno Valley community with convenient shopping hours and regular events throughout the year. Located at Town Circle, the center provides a full-service shopping experience with ample amenities for families and shoppers.
demographics: Moreno Valley Mall primarily serves a diverse, family-oriented demographic in the Inland Empire region with a trade area encompassing middle-income households. The center attracts a broad age range of shoppers, with strong representation from young families, Hispanic and African American communities, and value-conscious consumers seeking accessible retail options. Typical visitors prioritize convenience, entertainment value, and affordable shopping options, with the movie theater serving as a key draw for evening and weekend traffic from the surrounding suburban neighborhoods.
